title: Begum Rokeya (Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain)
summary: Born in 1880 in rural Rangpur, in present-day Bangladesh, Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain became an educator and writer who campaigned for Muslim women's schooling and against their seclusion. Encyclopedia.com dates her Sakhawat Memorial Girls' School in Calcutta to 1911 and her Bengal women's association to 1916; The Daily Star dates the school to 1909. She died in 1932.

uncertainty.note: Birth and death years agree across sources. The school is dated to 1911 (Encyclopedia.com) and 1909 (The Daily Star); the marriage date is given as unknown by Encyclopedia.com.
